issues.description: The generic shell style specifies a /usr/bin/zsh shebang, while this test uses Bash. The choice is required by its BASH_SOURCE usage and by MANIFEST.yml invoking HarmonyOS HNP Bash, so this is a non-blocking style exception.
issues.fix_suggestion: Record the Bash-only HNP test exception; changing interpreters would require a compatible shell and script rewrite.

issues.description: git diff --check flags blank unified-diff context lines 5 and 12. Their single spaces are required context prefixes emitted by refresh-patch --auto, not trailing whitespace in the source; removing them would alter the generated patch.
issues.fix_suggestion: Keep the generated unified-diff context unchanged.
